summary:
Implementation plan to recreate the exact 'Last Seen Mugshot' interface from user screenshots:
- Redesign LobbyScreen with Game Code card, Copy, Share Invite, Show QR, Red/Green min-3 player requirement status banner, 'Your crew ✳' Oddball cards with Host star badge, 'Change Oddball' & 'SEE ALL PLAYERS' buttons, Game Mode card with 'EDIT ->', and sticky 'NEED X MORE' / 'START GAME ->' dynamic neon lime button.
- Create 'GAME FEEL' modal bottom sheet with INTENSE / STANDARD / CHILL presets, circle radius pills (50m to 10km), round length and head start dropdowns, and zone physics info.
- Redesign 'SCAN TO JOIN' QR modal with neon lime corner brackets and glowing game code.
- Blend signature Neon Lime (#C8FF00) accents with liquid glass capsule effects and water shadows.
